# Bug reports & feature requests

Please use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/jeffreyhaen/mssql-axi/issues) for:

- Bug reports (include `mssql-axi --version`, the failing command, the full output, and the server type — local SQL Server or Azure SQL)
- Feature requests
- Questions about usage

## Security

**Do not file public issues for security vulnerabilities.** Email security concerns to the address in the maintainer's GitHub profile.
